question: Estimate the TV reach (cumulative) of a 30-day prime-time TVC campaign on Hindi GEC channels.
idealClarificationQuestions: Hindi GEC = Star Plus, Colors, Sony, Zee TV, &TV — primarily? Yes — top 4-5 Hindi GEC channels.
Campaign = ~1,500-2,000 GRPs over 30 days? Use 1,800 GRPs.
Reach to households or individuals? Individuals.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Frame the approach
expectedLogicalStructure.description: GRP = Reach × Frequency. Solve for reach.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: BARC-defined Hindi GEC TG (Target Group) universe: Hindi-speaking states + urban Hindi viewers = ~50 crore TV individuals.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Typical reach build at 1,800 GRPs prime-time GEC: ~70-75% of TG (1+ reach).

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Effective reach (3+, the marketing-relevant cutoff): ~50-55% of TG = ~25-27 crore.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Frequency: 1,800 / 36 ≈ 5 (average individual sees the ad 5 times).

benchmarkAssumptions.parameter: BARC-defined Hindi GEC TG (Target Group) universe
benchmarkAssumptions.value: Hindi-speaking states + urban Hindi viewers = ~50 crore TV individuals.

benchmarkAssumptions.parameter: Typical reach build at 1,800 GRPs prime-time GEC

benchmarkAssumptions.value: 50 cr × 0.72 = ~36 crore individuals reached at least once.

calculationFlow: BARC-defined Hindi GEC TG (Target Group) universe: Hindi-speaking states + urban Hindi viewers = ~50 crore TV individuals.
Typical reach build at 1,800 GRPs prime-time GEC: ~70-75% of TG (1+ reach).
1+ Reach: 50 cr × 0.72 = ~36 crore individuals reached at least once.
Effective reach (3+, the marketing-relevant cutoff): ~50-55% of TG = ~25-27 crore.

finalAnswerRange.ideal: Frequency: 1,800 / 36 ≈ 5 (average individual sees the ad 5 times).
